notes.title: July Development Progress Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Thank you so much for your support.
I'd like to share the latest development update and some recent activity![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325390/AirBoost/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h2]1. Shop System & Ability Enhancements[/h2][p]We’ve recently added a new system to enhance abilities using [b]chips[/b]!
These chips can be purchased and equipped onto crystals to boost your powers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/452e9f0ffab5445d76a064177c23d4baff2b5d02.png"][/img]
(Currently, the abilities are in their first draft.)[/p][p]This design aims to add more depth and variety to the gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]Since we now have a shop system, we’ve also added a [b]money system[/b]![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="fnrnaWL1wZI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Enemies now drop coins during battles, and you can use them to purchase items.
Unexpectedly, this led to quite a few gameplay changes,
and we're currently refining the finer details.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]2. Stage Development[/h2][p]We're continuing to develop new stages.
In line with the new coin system, we’re planning to add optional [b]side stages[/b] for farming money.[/p][p]The [b]main story stages[/b] are also in development,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/654230fed8a147cb75673f819d2f5c68cae62079.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/140b7715069ba0695940a82e6a22429c8827eb9c.png"][/img]
[/p][previewyoutube="l6clPsMgvOo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]and we’re gradually adding more interactions between characters![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/1a096076f15b77f34f883dc3250795e5a6e695e8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/23f6b610c482830e3a2f4d65b9ba09e5c3dc481f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]3. Game CG[/h2][p]Some great news!
All the event CG illustrations we commissioned are now complete![/p][p]They look fantastic, and we’re incredibly grateful to the illustrator.
They will be featured in our upcoming new trailer—please look forward to it![/p][hr][/hr][h2]4. Overall Schedule[/h2][p]As mentioned, the CG work is done.
We previously worked as a 2-person team, but from now on it’s back to solo development—just me![/p][p]I’m also optimizing many parts during development, so progress is a bit slower,
but I’m aiming for a release in [b]Q4 2025[/b] as my current goal![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you so much to everyone who’s been following and supporting the game.
I’ll keep sharing more development updates on Discord and X (formerly Twitter),
so feel free to follow and interact![/p][hr][/hr][p]This month’s update cover illustration was drawn by
Japanese illustrator すぎむらさん[b] (@poke_kaikai)[/b].[/p][p]It features [b]Dorota and Agata[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/a26784c510fe0977bfd2ffbc4140d0384582af19.png"][/img]
I’m very grateful—it's a beautiful and soft art style that I love![/p]

notes.title: May DEMO Update! Version V280
notes.notes:
May DEMO Update! Version V280
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/c0dd8aef0f3f79ce7a23be2de800262dec753e29.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
We’ve recently gathered a lot of feedback and prepared a revised version of the DEMO.

Here are the main updates for this DEMO:
1.Added game save functionality
2.Added save function for game settings (such as audio and display options)
3.Added quick keyboard control style selection at the start, offering two styles:
　　a. Arrow keys (movement) + ZXC (attack/jump) control style
　　b. WASD (movement) + JK + Space (attack/jump) control style
　　(Settings UI also allows individual key customization)
4.More complete mouse support – all in-game buttons can now be clicked with the mouse
5.Agate’s invincibility mechanism adjusted to a shield with hint indicators
6.In-game control hints will appear at the bottom right corner
7.Reduced player control restrictions, making controls more responsive
8.game bug fixes

Some levels have been adjusted, but no new levels are added this time!
Overall, the DEMO content remains as before.

We hope this brings everyone a better experience!
Please feel free to try it out and share your feedback.
We’ll continue to adjust and fix issues in the future.

Feedback we’ve received so far:
　　1. “Return to Title” function in the game
This feature is currently in development and will be added soon!

↓↓ At the beginning of the game, you can quickly choose between two keyboard control styles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/c7a506d4a37056226fdaf6d28afee1859e3a2be4.png[/img]

↓↓ In-game control hints are now displayed at the bottom right corner!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/6a14cb82ade0dd642e4f910c44555b7ef91c99c7.png[/img]

This month also happens to be the developer's birthday.
I drew an illustration of Dorota eating cake!
The game is still being improved. Thank you all for your support!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/3d4f6e649f63de5be7ed8a3b49f73c845f55540a.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo v0.252 Update!

Demo v0.252 Update
Thank you all for your feedback!
Today, we’ve updated to v0.252, focusing on improving controls and the overall gameplay experience.

Our game AirBoost Airship Knight just received a new update to the demo version v0.252!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3439090/AirBoost__Demo/

Update Highlights:

1.Added Coyote Time – now you can jump shortly after leaving a platform

2.Added gamepad button prompts

3.Fixed a nameplate error on Agate's door in the game scene

We’ll continue working hard on development.

notes.title: Demo v0.24 Update! Thank you all for playing during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is FilterGame.
The AirBoost Airship Knight demo has been live for a week now!

Steam DEMO Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3439090/AirBoost__Demo/

During this time, we’ve released multiple updates,
bringing the game to version v0.24!
We've fixed bugs and adjusted level difficulty,
making the experience more balanced.
Huge thanks to everyone who has played and given feedback!

v0.24 Update Changes:
1.Improved font readability
2.Lowered difficulty in some stages
3.Added more checkpoints to reduce repeated dialogues on retries
4.Enhanced visual effects (library stage fire effect improved)
5.Fixed bugs (unusual enemy and item movement in the library stage)
6.Added a new hint ,Rita will now call you, unlocking a side quest

The demo has now been played by over 600 people!
We truly appreciate all your support!

We’ll continue improving the game based on your feedback,
ensuring a better and more balanced gameplay experience!

Common concerns such as:
1.Improving user-friendliness
2.Balancing difficulty
will also be addressed in future updates.

We’d love your feedback!
Google Form:
https://forms.gle/PWeMNrntvQT9YsXx6

Discord:
https://discord.gg/xQaCPAbe

Thank you all for your support!!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest (2/25 - 3/4) - AirBoost: Airship Knight Demo Release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171195/0131209ae0bf42b6bbfa1da1e8328152d759ad73.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone's support, after a long period of development,
we have finally completed our first demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3439090/

This demo lets you experience the game's prologue!
Join Dorota, the Airship Knight, and her companions as their adventure begins!

Demo Features:

1.Approx. 20-30 minutes of gameplay
2.Play through the entire prologue (Experience the full story introduction!)
3.Includes 5 stages, 2 unlockable special weapons, and 2 CG illustrations
4.No save function yet (must be completed in one session)
5.Supports keyboard, Xbox controller, and Steam Deck
6.For Switch or PS4 controllers,
use Steam Big Picture mode to recognize them before launching the game


We’d love to hear your feedback!
Your thoughts and suggestions will help us improve the game!

Feedback Form:
[url=https://forms.gle/PWeMNrntvQT9YsXx6]https://forms.gle/PWeMNrntvQT9YsXx6[/url]

Bug reports are also welcome!
We’ll be actively fixing any issues over the next few days.

Adding the game to your wishlist is the biggest support you can give us! 
We appreciate your support!

Thank you all!
